3.name: third person
3.plain: anyone or anything else: he, she, it, they

M.name: masculine
M.plain: one of the two genders; also used for mixed groups

DEF.name: definite article
DEF.plain: the prefix ha- 'the', which doubles the next consonant

QTL.name: qatal (suffix conjugation)
QTL.plain: the verb form that marks person with endings, mostly used for completed events: he did, he has done

Q.name: question particle
Q.plain: the prefix hă- that turns a statement into a yes/no question

OBJ.name: object marker
OBJ.plain: the word ʾēt (ʾet-, ʾōt-) placed before a definite direct object; it has no English equivalent

DU.name: dual
DU.plain: exactly two, or a natural pair such as hands or eyes

CSTR.name: construct state
CSTR.plain: the bound form a noun takes when another noun or a suffix follows it: 'word of'

YQTL.name: yiqtol (long prefix conjugation)
YQTL.plain: the verb form that marks person with prefixes, used mostly for future, habitual and modal events: he will do, he used to do, he may do

WAYY.name: wayyiqtol prefix
WAYY.plain: the prefix wa- plus doubling that turns a short prefix form into the main past-narrative verb: and he did

WQTL.name: weqatal prefix
WQTL.plain: the prefix wə- on a qatal form when it continues a command, future or habit: and he will do

JUSS.name: jussive
JUSS.plain: the short prefix form used to wish or command for a third person, and with ʾal for 'do not': let him do

COH.name: cohortative
COH.plain: the first-person prefix form lengthened with -â, expressing resolve or request: let me do, let us do

PTCP.name: participle
PTCP.plain: a verbal adjective that can also act as a noun or as 'is doing'

PASS.name: passive
PASS.plain: the subject undergoes the action; used here of the qal passive participle (šāmûr 'guarded')

INF.name: infinitive construct
INF.plain: the verbal noun used after prepositions: to do, when doing

NIPH.name: niphal
NIPH.plain: the n-stem, mostly passive or middle: was guarded, guarded himself

PIEL.name: piel
PIEL.plain: the stem that doubles the middle root letter, often making a state happen or intensifying

HIPH.name: hiphil
HIPH.plain: the h-stem, mostly causative: made someone do

HOPH.name: hophal
HOPH.plain: the passive of the hiphil: was made to do

HITP.name: hithpael
HITP.plain: the stem with the prefix hit-, mostly reflexive or reciprocal: did to or for oneself, to each other

DIR.name: directional ending
DIR.plain: the unstressed ending -â meaning 'towards': to Egypt, homewards

REL.name: relative marker
REL.plain: the word ʾăšer (later še-) that opens a clause describing a noun: who, which, that

INFABS.name: infinitive absolute
INFABS.plain: the free verbal noun used for emphasis, for an accompanying action, or as a command
